title: Young Female Graduate Celebrates with Family, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square-format snapshot capturing a young woman in academic graduation attire, including a mortarboard cap and gown, surrounded outdoors by family members beneath the leafy canopy of a tree. The surrounding women wear stylish mid-1960s winter outerwear, pillbox-style hats, and bouffant hairstyles. One older woman looks proudly towards the graduate as hands pass a commencement program or diploma. The photo is dated February 1966 on the front margin, reflecting a mid-year commencement ceremony during a decade marked by increasing female enrollment in higher education across the United States.
